_comment: This manifest documents the translation file structure. It is not part of a formal standard but follows conventions from i18next (folder/namespace layout) and the eForms SDK (language metadata and key patterns).

keyConvention.description: Keys are derived deterministically from the ESPD-EDM data model structure. The renderer computes the key at runtime from the stable section ID and request path — no key storage needed in the data model itself.
keyConvention.stableIdRule: For sections with a unique code (not 'OT'), use the code field. For OT-type entries (shared code 'OT'), use the tag field (e.g. OT65, OT57) as the stable identifier.

patterns.part.title.{partNumber}: Heading for a form part (I through VI)
patterns.part.description.{partNumber}: Short description of a form part
patterns.criterion.name.{stableId}: Human-readable name of a criterion or form section
patterns.criterion.description.{stableId}: Longer description of a criterion (when different from name)
patterns.question.label.{stableId}.{pathSegments}: Label for a form field. pathSegments is the requestpath after the first segment, with '/' replaced by '.'
patterns.ui.{elementName}: Shared UI element text (buttons, validation messages, etc.)

examples.requestpath: OT65_Economic Operator Micro, Small or Medium-sized Enterprise/QG1/Q1
